fields.office: National Weather Service River Forecast Center, Fort Worth
fields.title: Cedar River forecast discussion for Riverbend (RBDM7)

sections.heading: Rainfall
sections.text: Radar-estimated rainfall of 3.1 to 4.6 inches fell over the upper basin since Friday morning, more than the 2 to 3 inches forecast.

sections.heading: Current river conditions
sections.text: The Cedar River at Milford rose 4.2 feet in 6 hours and is above flood stage. Flow is increasing at all upstream gauges.

sections.heading: Forecast reasoning
sections.text: The higher rainfall raised the forecast flow at Milford. Routing the flood wave downstream raises the forecast crest at Riverbend by 2.6 feet and moves the crest later in the day Monday.

sections.heading: Uncertainty
sections.text: Another 1 to 2 inches of rain Sunday would raise the crest further. The forecast does not include rain beyond 24 hours.

fields.nextIssuance: The next forecast will be issued by 1000 PM CST tonight.
